	Pass the full identity to `viz.render`, for example `{ "pattern": "pattern:viz:simple-bar", "theme": "dark", "brand": "B", "output": { "svg": true, "includeNormalizedSpec": true } }`. The source supplies rows, encoding, title, description, and presentation. Explicit input fields that conflict with the pattern are rejected. Authoring-only identities return a typed error explaining the unsupported semantics.

	## Authoring and regeneration
b8f4220f0ba730d871dc75e0aea0467aa53eeb10 102 102
	
b8f4220f0ba730d871dc75e0aea0467aa53eeb10 103 103
	The original specifications remain available to Storybook and the pattern recommender. The public path preserves supported static authoring semantics; unsupported facets, layering, stacking, interactions, or encodings remain explicit limitations rather than approximate chart substitutions.
b8f4220f0ba730d871dc75e0aea0467aa53eeb10 104 104
	
b8f4220f0ba730d871dc75e0aea0467aa53eeb10 105 105
	```sh
b8f4220f0ba730d871dc75e0aea0467aa53eeb10 106 106
	pnpm exec tsx scripts/product-reality/s195-pattern-sources.ts --check
b8f4220f0ba730d871dc75e0aea0467aa53eeb10 107 107
	pnpm exec tsx scripts/product-reality/s195-pattern-census.ts --measure
b8f4220f0ba730d871dc75e0aea0467aa53eeb10 108 108
	pnpm exec tsx scripts/product-reality/s195-pattern-census.ts --check
b8f4220f0ba730d871dc75e0aea0467aa53eeb10 111 111 1
	`--measure` runs the real public handler and certification before writing observations, registry, and documentation. `--check` derives the generated bytes from the retained observations and current source pins; the contract suite separately reruns the public calls to reject handler drift. `OODS_PATTERN_CENSUS_ROOT` or `--root <path>` selects a repository root; `--observations <path>` selects retained observations.
